node.statement: The root claim has been mathematically corrected from the false quantifier ‘all reals A’ to the explicit hypothesis A>0 (while retaining Lambda>0). Therefore the verifier’s example A=-1 is outside the corrected theorem domain. Under A>0, since N is a subset of all fibers, sum_{Q in N}|d_Q| <= l_chi=sum_Q|d_Q|, and multiplication by A preserves the inequality; together with node 1.2.1 this yields 1 <= A*l_chi+Lambda*sum_{Q in F}|d_Q| and hence the asserted bound after subtraction and division by Lambda>0.
